#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
rundir="$base/run"
pidfile="$rundir/worker.pid"
lockfile="$rundir/control.lock"
worker="$base/worker.py"

mkdir -p "$rundir"
exec 9>"$lockfile"
flock -x 9

read_pid()
{
    PID=$(sed -n '1p' "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null || :)
    case "$PID" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    [ "$PID" -gt 1 ] 2>/dev/null || return 1
}

process_exists()
{
    [ -d "/proc/$1" ] || return 1
    state=$(sed -n 's/^State:[[:space:]]*\([A-Z]\).*/\1/p' "/proc/$1/status" 2>/dev/null || :)
    [ -n "$state" ] && [ "$state" != Z ] && [ "$state" != X ]
}

is_worker()
{
    process_exists "$1" || return 1
    first=$(tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$1/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p')
    second=$(tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$1/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '2p')
    case "$first" in
        python|python[0-9]*|*/python|*/python[0-9]*) ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
    [ "$second" = "$worker" ]
}

classify()
{
    PID=
    if [ ! -e "$pidfile" ]; then
        KIND=missing
    elif ! read_pid; then
        KIND=stale
    elif ! process_exists "$PID"; then
        KIND=stale
    elif is_worker "$PID"; then
        KIND=worker
    else
        KIND=foreign
    fi
}

same_pidfile()
{
    [ "$(sed -n '1p' "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null || :)" = "$1" ]
}

start_worker()
{
    classify
    case "$KIND" in
        worker)
            printf 'worker already running (pid %s)\n' "$PID"
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            if [ -n "$PID" ]; then
                printf 'stale PID file found (pid %s); removing it\n' "$PID"
            else
                printf 'stale PID file found (invalid PID); removing it\n'
            fi
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'PID file points to another process (pid %s); leaving it running\n' "$PID"
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            ;;
        missing)
            ;;
    esac

    (exec 9>&-; exec python "$worker" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1) &
    newpid=$!

    tries=0
    while [ "$tries" -lt 20 ]; do
        if is_worker "$newpid"; then
            tmp="$pidfile.$$"
            printf '%s\n' "$newpid" > "$tmp"
            mv -f "$tmp" "$pidfile"
            printf 'worker started (pid %s)\n' "$newpid"
            return 0
        fi
        process_exists "$newpid" || break
        tries=$((tries + 1))
        sleep 0.1
    done

    rm -f "$pidfile" "$pidfile.$$"
    printf 'worker failed to start\n' >&2
    return 1
}

stop_worker()
{
    classify
    case "$KIND" in
        missing)
            printf 'worker already stopped (no PID file)\n'
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            if [ -n "$PID" ]; then
                printf 'stale PID file found (pid %s); removing it\n' "$PID"
            else
                printf 'stale PID file found (invalid PID); removing it\n'
            fi
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            return 0
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'PID file points to another process (pid %s); leaving it running\n' "$PID"
            rm -f "$pidfile"
            return 0
            ;;
        worker)
            oldpid=$PID
            if ! is_worker "$oldpid"; then
                printf 'worker changed before stop; refusing to signal pid %s\n' "$oldpid" >&2
                return 1
            fi
            kill "$oldpid"
            tries=0
            while process_exists "$oldpid" && [ "$tries" -lt 50 ]; do
                tries=$((tries + 1))
                sleep 0.1
            done
            if process_exists "$oldpid"; then
                printf 'worker did not stop (pid %s)\n' "$oldpid" >&2
                return 1
            fi
            same_pidfile "$oldpid" && rm -f "$pidfile"
            printf 'worker stopped (pid %s)\n' "$oldpid"
            ;;
    esac
}

worker_status()
{
    classify
    case "$KIND" in
        worker)
            printf 'worker running (pid %s)\n' "$PID"
            return 0
            ;;
        stale)
            if [ -n "$PID" ]; then
                printf 'stale PID file (pid %s is not running)\n' "$PID"
            else
                printf 'stale PID file (invalid PID)\n'
            fi
            return 1
            ;;
        foreign)
            printf 'PID file points to another process (pid %s)\n' "$PID"
            return 2
            ;;
        missing)
            printf 'worker stopped (no PID file)\n'
            return 3
            ;;
    esac
}

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s {start|stop|status}\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

case "$1" in
    start) start_worker ;;
    stop) stop_worker ;;
    status) worker_status ;;
    *) printf 'usage: %s {start|stop|status}\n' "$0" >&2; exit 64 ;;
esac
